appStoreMetadata.description:
ZICA BELLA — FOR THE FEARLESS

Not your basic streetwear brand. Zica Bella is for the ones who go against the grain — gothic-inspired fits, acid-wash pieces, and oversized silhouettes built different from everything else out there.

WHY YOU'RE HERE
→ Drops that actually go hard
→ Oversized fits for that effortless look
→ Acid-wash pieces you won't find anywhere else
→ Gothic aesthetic, zero compromise

SHOP THE APP
Browse collections, cop your fits, and track your orders — all from your phone. Fast checkout, real-time order tracking, and drops before anyone else sees them.

ZICA AI
Stuck on sizing or styling? Zica AI's got you — your personal style assistant, built right into the app.

THE VIBE
This isn't fast fashion. It's a whole mood. Streetwear for people who dress like they mean it.

Download now and build a fit that says something.
